voice.speaker: laertes-restored
voice.caption: Laertes is bathed and anointed inside the farmhouse.
Athena makes him taller and stronger, restoring royal presence.

voice.speaker: dolius
voice.caption: Dolius and his sons return from the fields, recognize Odysseus, and join the feast.
